label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 49
text:
§ 49



 We should have been able to meet with many more real, natural
          homoeopathic cures of this kind if, on the one hand, the attention of observers had been
          more directed to them, and, on the other hand, if nature had not been so deficient in
          helpful homoeopathic diseases.
